 In  BA1 No.1706 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. S.R.S. Gill, Advocate for the applicant.
Mrs. Manisha Rana Singh, A.G.A. with Mrs. Shivali Joshi, Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. P.C. Petshali and Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, Advocates for the complainant.
2. Counter affidavit filed on behalf of State is taken on record.
The delay condonation application stands disposed of.

3. This is first bail application moved by the applicant seeking regular bail in F.I.R. No. 154 of 2023,
under Section 376 I.P.C., registered at Police Station I.T.I., District Udham Singh Nagar on 21.06.2023.

entities.text: Police Station I.T.I., District Udham Singh Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is falsely implicated in the instant crime;
has no criminal history and is languishing in jail since 23.06.2023.

It is further contended that applicant and complainant were in a relationship for last more than 5 years and, from statement of victim before Doctor, it is revealed that physical relationship between them was consensual.

Learned counsel for the applicant has drawn attention of this Court to the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., where she has stated that physical relationship was established by the applicant in the year 2020.
This, according to learned counsel for applicant, is an improvement.
He submits that in case the applicant is granted bail, he will not misuse the same and will furnish the bail surety as per the satisfaction of this Court.

5. Per contra, learned counsel for the complainant contended that the applicant abused the complainant under false promise of marriage; although, he never intended to enter into any marital relationship.

1 6.

Considering the submission of learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion as to the final merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves bail at this stage.
7. The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant, namely, Madan Gopal Sharma @ Amit Sharma be released on bail, on executing personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of like amount, to the satisfaction of Court concerned.
9.
It is made clear that any observation made by this Court is only for the purpose of disposal of bail application.
It shall not be taken into consideration at all in any other proceedings.

(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 18.08.2023 Arpan BA1/1706/2023 on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/23555686/
2
